# iosxe_voice_class_stun_usage (Data Source)

This data source can read the Voice Class STUN Usage configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iosxe_voice_class_stun_usage" "example" {
  tag = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag` (Number) Voice class dialpeer group tag

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the retrieved object.
- `stun_usage_firewall_traversal_flowdata` (Boolean) use flowdata
- `stun_usage_ice_lite` (Boolean) Configure ICE in Ice-Lite Mode
